stage: discovery-only OSA pair context and frozen primary ranking

node_context.source: frozen discovery_score from GSE75097 OSA/severity/AHI plus GSE71356 IH evidence

primary_pair_context.name: r_OSA
primary_pair_context.interpretation: dual-node discovery context support; not a physical interaction probability

percentile_transform.formula: midrank percentile within the frozen 31,125-pair universe: (average_rank - 0.5) / N

model_sensitivities.bidirectional_conservative_PPI: min(p_PPI_AB, p_PPI_BA); diagnostic sensitivity only and not calibrated
model_sensitivities.long_protein_multi_window: separate later sensitivity; it cannot replace checkpoint-native primary inference

coexpression_diagnostics.GSE75097: Pearson correlation across the frozen 46 primary expression samples followed by global empirical-Bayes Fisher-z shrinkage
coexpression_diagnostics.GSE71356: subject-centered descriptive Pearson correlation across 16 crossover samples followed by global empirical-Bayes Fisher-z shrinkage

posthoc_model_baselines.interpretation: frozen post-hoc branch ablations; no retraining and no validation selection

prohibited: reading CPAP, adipose, pediatric single-cell or proteome outcomes
reading known-PPI or pathway labels before ranking is frozen
calling r_OSA or the combined priority score a physical interaction probability
filtering the primary pair universe using direction, correlation, truncation, order gap or model coherence
changing formulas or weights after validation
